title: Prove the all-height source floor K/N > 3.054 for selected nested widths
body:
This scoped proof raises the selected nested compiler's lower width coefficient from 2.943 to **K/N > 3.054**. Together with the inherited upper proof from [PR #5109](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5109), the interval is **3.054 < K/N < 3.0694**, with endpoint ratio below 1.0051. Here H = 64215200000000, N = 2^H and K = ceil(log2 B_N)/H. This tightens the estimate of the unchanged permitted width; it does not reduce the width or improve the complete kappa calculation. Selected kappa remains 60403/20000000.

[Proof, exact scope and credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cf7c21187a9d2d0ea689902b8727617affe70cde/research/separated-source-telescope/README.md), [deterministic receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cf7c21187a9d2d0ea689902b8727617affe70cde/research/separated-source-telescope/RESULT.json), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cf7c21187a9d2d0ea689902b8727617affe70cde/research/separated-source-telescope/SOURCES.json), and [independent counter](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cf7c21187a9d2d0ea689902b8727617affe70cde/research/separated-source-telescope/verify.py) are at reviewed head `cf7c21187a9d2d0ea689902b8727617affe70cde`. Base and every consumed source pin: `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`.

The new all-height identity uses eligible ordered mixed products F_d(c), target count W and paid count Q:

```text
S_n = W Q^g + (W-Q) sum_(d=0..g-1) F_d(c)
S_n - W^(g+1) = (Q-W) sum_(d=0..g-1) (Q^d W^(g-d)-F_d(c)).
```

For the default-height flow with every paid rank below every target rank and Q >= W, this proves S_n >= W^(g+1). It also gives the exact equality threshold and within-height monotonicity. Every missing-parent source remains charged. Applying the floor to the actual power-1024 completion/split rule yields the new lower coefficient without constructing N or its histogram. The upper coefficient remains a cited premise and is not independently reproved here.

From the repository root, Python 3.12 and standard library only:

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/separated-source-telescope/verify.py
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/separated-source-telescope/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/separated-source-telescope
```

Expected direct result: `PASS_SEPARATED_SOURCE_TELESCOPE K/N>3.054 no_new_kappa`. Registered normal/optimized checks pass on Python 3.12.13; optimized 3.14.7 also passes. Evidence includes 864 small merged flows, 12 complete literal source/exit comparisons, 708 within-height checks, 16 distinct selected v=1 boundary cases and six discriminating controls. Committed-byte and official 11-file export checks pass; a fresh Git-free extraction passes under optimized Python and rejects source-byte and receipt corruption. The optional source-history preflight refused the shallow checkout; no full-history pass is claimed. All source pins use the initial contribution commit's direct parent, and the export includes every declared live input.

This is a written uniform count proof with finite corroboration. It does not admit physical stock, routing, owned storage, native operators, precision/tapes, whole-job adapters, outer recovery or the full multiplication theorem. No selected cold replay or formal proof-kernel run was performed. Hosted CI and external review remain separate.

The [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5061#discussioncomment-19150437) follows the source-count handoff at priority 7. Final overlap covered 363 open PRs, 4,582 Discussion records and all 7,091 tracked README/TASK notes. Canonical main still matched the base; unpublished work and arbitrary diffs are outside that coverage.

Credit @JoyboyBrian for the census in [PR #5067](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5067), @thakrarsagar for the bracket and handoff in [PR #5026](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5026), @petalas for the inherited upper proof, and @unpaidmoon for the height-one identity in [PR #5273](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5273). The all-height result extends those premises. The flow from @zxv in [PR #4436](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4436) retains Jacob Alan Sussman's lockstep credit; the selected invoice from @1337isnot1337 and @zxv in [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470) retains its full native/compiler lineage. Source notices are unchanged. Prepared by @aliromman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, code, verification and review; Apache-2.0. No independent human review is claimed.
